name: Aoze 1.2.3
bodyHtml:
Aoze 1.2.3: Clips play in the preview again.

Improved

  • Loading spinners keep turning even when Windows animations are turned off, so you can see the preview is being prepared.

Fixed

  • In the installed app, no clip could be previewed: "This clip can't be previewed here" showed for every clip, and for every result. The app's security policy blocked local videos; it now allows them (and only them).

Download Aoze_1.2.3_x64-setup.exe, run it, done (FFmpeg and every engine are included).
Aoze 1.1.0 and later update themselves: they offer the new version when it is out.
The installer is per-user (no admin rights). It is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen
may show "Windows protected your PC": choose "More info", then "Run anyway".
